summary: Excellent bash practices: set -euo pipefail, proper quoting, readonly constants, robust error handling via die(). Workflow uses proper job chaining with needs:, clear outputs, least-privilege permissions. Script well-factored (read→apply→report) with clear separation of concerns. Minor issues: IFS scoping at line 70 (works but unidiomatic); test expectations scattered across three associative arrays (lines 83-95) make adding cases error-prone. Fully hermetic, no external services. Overall production-ready.
